text:
Amanda (CSM): Heads up — BigCo (whale) shows ~70% drop in Redwood API generation usage for their 'agentify' flow since last month. Drop started after they onboarded a new DS and kicked off a competitor pilot. Any ideas?
Devon (SE): Is that across all regions or just us-west? Any error spikes in the logs?
Amanda (CSM): No error spikes, latency looks normal. Drop is primarily generation token volume; embeddings and reranks stable. AE mentioned they are 'evaluating alternatives' last week.
Neil (Support): Quick check on keys — no auth failures. Calls/day for their main key: ~1.2k -> 360 over 30d. No 500s.
Maya (CS): I messaged their ML lead (Jasper) — asked for a QBR. Jasper said procurement is comparing pricing and a small internal pilot is live. Waiting on availability. :thinking_face:
Devon (SE): We should offer a short enablement/demo that shows batching + caching + prompt edits to cut tokens. I can prep a 20m session + simple cost/perf slide.
Amanda (CSM): +1. Also need an exec-level touch (CFO/procurement). @Sasha (Sales) can you intro?
Sasha (Sales): I can do an intro to their CFO and procurement. Need a one-pager and a clear ask (what we want from them).
Amanda (CSM): Proposed ask: 3-month complimentary burst (high qps) + 15% list discount if they commit to a Dedicated trial within 30 days. One-pager + pricing comp by EOD.
deploy-bot: Demo slot created: 2024-06-05 16:00 PST — Devon, Amanda, Maya invited; Jasper (BigCo) pending. :calendar:
Maya (CS): Also they reported higher hallucination count after our last model tweak. Need concrete eval prompts and sample outputs. @Neil (Support) can you pull top anomalous responses from their logs (last 14 days)?
Neil (Support): Pulling samples now. Will attach 5 examples and open ops ticket CS-496 with context.
Devon (SE): For the demo I'll include: 1) cost delta slide (batching, lower seq len), 2) quick prompt fixes, 3) rollback plan if quality worsens. Keep it pragmatic — CFO cares about $/1000 tokens, ML lead cares about hallucination numbers.
Amanda (CSM): Timeline check: one-pager by EOD (Amanda), samples in 24h (Neil), demo on 6/5 (Devon), Sasha to intro to procurement before demo. If procurement stalls, fallback = extend hosted credits for 30 days. @Sasha (Sales) pls hold that option. :thumbsup:
Sasha (Sales): Holding. I'll coordinate with Procurement and loop legal only if they ask for SOW details.
Amanda (CSM): Thanks team — goal is to shift them off the competitor pilot and into a short, measurable trial. I'll update thread when Jasper replies.
note: This thread captures a short triage for a high-value customer's sudden usage decline, coordination across CS/SE/Sales/Support, and concrete next steps for a renewal-risk scenario.
